evidence: The multiline list is `before_filter :ensure_logged_in, only: [...]` (app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:8-28), not skip_before_filter. skip_before_filter at line 32 is a single-line array. The base version ended with `:bookmark]` with no trailing comma, and the repo has no .rubocop.yml, so no project style or lint rule requires one.

app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:105-113: `TopicUser.find_by(...)` returns nil when the user has no topic_users row (for example, a user who was only mentioned), and `tu.notification_level` then raises NoMethodError, giving a 500. The toggle is also not idempotent: watching/tracking goes to regular on the first hit and to muted on the next (prefetch or re-click), so the result depends on how many times the link is hit. The 'can re-subscribe' part is overstated because the level never goes up. Fix: use TopicUser.change(current_user.id, topic_id, notification_level: muted), which handles the missing row.

app/views/email/notification.html.erb:6 and :18 both render %{respond_instructions} when context_posts are present. The base 56abd247 has the same two blocks, so this PR only reformatted them and did not add the duplicate. It is arguably intentional: once after the new post and once at the footer after the long context.

app/views/email/notification.html.erb:10 has class='.previous-discussion'. lib/email/styles.rb:75 styles the selector '.previous-discussion', which only matches class 'previous-discussion', so the style is never applied. The bug predates this PR, but the PR rewrote this line.

config/routes.rb:440-441 map GET t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe to topics#unsubscribe, which changes TopicUser.notification_level (topics_controller.rb:98-116). protect_from_forgery (application_controller.rb:21) does not cover GET, so a cross-site request could lower or mute a logged-in user's topic notifications. An email link has to be a GET, so switching to POST alone would break the feature. Impact is low (it only lowers notifications and requires login via ensure_logged_in at topics_controller.rb:28). The better fix is a GET confirmation page that mutates via PUT, or a signed token.

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/controllers/topic-unsubscribe.js.es6:5 defines `stopNotificiationsText` and templates/topic/unsubscribe.hbs:3 uses the same misspelling. The names match so it works; this is a naming fix only.

spec/components/email/message_builder_spec.rb:169-176 passes unsubscribe_url but only asserts that the header is present. lib/email/message_builder.rb:107 still sets List-Unsubscribe to template_args[:user_preferences_url] and ignores unsubscribe_url, so the proposed assertion would fail. The spec's unsubscribe_url has no effect, and the test does not cover the new per-topic link (in the body or the header). Better: assert the body contains unsubscribe_url, or change the header code first if it should use the per-topic URL.
